headline: Small onshore SSE windswell — log it early or skip it.
today: Weak short-period stuff from the SSE, only chest-high on the sets and onshore from dawn. The best you'll get is a soft morning session on the log around the incoming tide before the SE cross-on fills in by afternoon. Not much here — grab a longboard or wait for the week to develop.

daysToWatch.note: Size jumps to 5ft but it's short-period and onshore all day. Only shot is the dawn cross-on window before the S wind takes over — expect it bumpy and closed-out.
The pick of the week. Light NNE/E winds through the morning clean up a chest-to-head-high swell — fish or groveler on the morning push before the SSE onshore returns by afternoon.
Blown out. 16-21mph onshore all day even with the better SE angle — not worth it.
